summary: The agent failed test_legacy_node_checks because it built a prepaid amortization workbook from scratch instead of using the existing financial-rollforward-workbook skill, ignored the mandatory validation scripts, and linked GL Balance to column O instead of column N in summary sheet. This update adds a prepaid-amortization variant to the existing skill, strengthens the recognition pattern for rollforward tasks with different terminology, and adds explicit decision rules to prevent skipping validation.
